requirements.statement: Enumerate assigned Nikon D810 cameras and distinguish them as CAM-A and CAM-B using local stable identity.
acceptance_evidence: Redacted Phase 0 inventory and reconnect report

requirements.statement: Bind each physical D810's SDK and WPD local identities to the same CAM-A or CAM-B alias, independent of connection order and USB port, while keeping real identities local.
acceptance_evidence: Cross-transport binding, connection-order, and port-swap report

requirements.statement: For each camera in one operator transaction, verify a dedicated WPD spool contains zero camera payload objects of any type and close WPD, capture exactly once to transient camera storage through Nikon SDK and close it, then reopen WPD to recover exactly one JPEG before moving from CAM-A to CAM-B.
acceptance_evidence: Single-slot hybrid sequential state trace

requirements.statement: Promote the only recovered JPEG to the canonical PC original only after .partial persistence, JPEG and size validation, SHA-256, atomic original.jpg rename, and reread verification; only then delete that exact recovered object and verify the WPD spool again contains zero payload objects of any type. Never delete or auto-adopt zero, multiple, late, invalid, failed-download, or failed-persistence candidates. WPD device datetime is diagnostic evidence only and is not an attribution key.
acceptance_evidence: Approved exact-object cleanup contract tests, ambiguity rejection, and real-device evidence

requirements.statement: Open at most one WPD baseline, Nikon SDK capture or Live View, or WPD recovery session at a time, never overlap transports, execute exclusive CAM-A to CAM-B sequential control, and require the operator to avoid the physical shutter and other camera applications during each active hybrid transaction.
acceptance_evidence: Trace proving WPD close, SDK capture and close, then WPD recovery with no overlap plus explicit exclusive-control confirmation

requirements.statement: On timeout, disconnect, partial capture, or ambiguity, retain available files and diagnostics, do not auto-retry, and finish FailedPartial.
acceptance_evidence: Fault and partial-persistence tests

requirements.statement: Provide Nikon SDK Live View start, preview-frame acquisition, and stop for exactly one operator-selected CAM-A or CAM-B; preview frames are never originals, stitch inputs, or capture candidates.
acceptance_evidence: Redacted one-camera Live View frame and lifecycle report

requirements.statement: Stop SDK Live View and close its session before the empty-spool WPD preflight, then complete WPD close, SDK capture and close, WPD recovery, canonical PC persistence, exact-object deletion, and empty-after verification before resuming the selected camera's SDK Live View.
acceptance_evidence: Ten hybrid handoff traces with no overlap or cross-body mismatch

requirements.statement: Treat each validated, hashed, atomically finalized, and reread-verified PC original.jpg as the canonical retained original after successful or failed transactions; persistent camera-side retention is not required, and only its just-recovered camera object may be deleted after that verification.
acceptance_evidence: PC canonical-original, exact cleanup, and quarantine persistence tests

requirements.statement: Export a stitched JPEG to the selected local folder.

requirements.statement: Show startup-session exclusive-control acknowledgement, both cameras' connection, identity, settings, card and Live View states, rig-profile ID/version/expiry, setup and correction readiness, staged progress, separate capture/stitch/export outcomes, and text-labelled blocker/caution/info notices on one capture dashboard.
acceptance_evidence: UI acceptance walkthrough and readiness contract tests

requirements.statement: Allow one-click capture without another dialog only when ready or ready-with-correction, suppress duplicate starts and all conflicting actions during an active transaction, and provide maintenance-separated setup/calibration, read-only camera settings, separate-job restitch, reviewed explicit export, read-only new-capture preparation, and measured physical-adjustment guidance.
acceptance_evidence: Setup and capture UI acceptance walkthrough and action-availability contract tests

requirements.statement: Show selected-camera Live View start/stop, target and connection state plus pre-capture stop and post-capture resume failures, while never treating preview frames as originals or stitch inputs.

requirements.statement: Run on Windows 11 x64; Phase 0 uses C++20/CMake and M3 adds .NET 10.

requirements.statement: Provisional p95 from capture start to stitched JPEG completion is 10 seconds; Phase 0 timing is measurement-only.

requirements.statement: Phase 0B requires 100 of 100 first-attempt paired transactions with no capture or recovery failure, mispair, original loss, ambiguous auto-adoption, or unrecoverable stop.
acceptance_evidence: 100-transaction machine-readable summary

requirements.statement: Record Live View lifecycle, empty-spool WPD preflight and close/reopen observations, exclusive-control confirmation, SDK capture and close, image download, canonical PC persistence verification, exact-object cleanup, empty-after verification, Live View resume, stitch, errors, requested/attempted/completed/terminal counts, rig-profile ID/version, baseline residual, proposed/applied/rejected transient correction, and rejection reason without cleanup tokens, object IDs, raw device dates, or identities in committed evidence.
acceptance_evidence: Structured event log, anonymous diagnostic report, setup assessment, and hybrid or handoff summary

requirements.statement: Keep images local, perform no MVP cloud upload, and exclude real identifiers and SDK material from commits.

requirements.statement: Do not add hardware shutter synchronization or guarantee actual shutter-opening skew.
